title: High cyclomatic complexity: _update_volume_xml (CCN=15)
detail: `_update_volume_xml` has a cyclomatic complexity of 15 over 38 lines (L416–470). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 2 sites (L827,L862)
detail: `except Exception` catches all exceptions without re-raising, swallowing unexpected errors silently. This hides failures and makes the caller unable to distinguish success from silent failure. Suggested fix: catch only the exception types the callee can raise, or use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()` for cleanup handlers.
